summary: Plutus Financial Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting a Third Amendment to its Merger Agreement with Choco Up Group Holdings Ltd, extending the Outside Date from June 30, 2026 to September 30, 2026. The original agreement, dated July 9, 2025, involves Plutus acquiring all outstanding equity interests in Choco Up in exchange for newly issued Class A and Class B ordinary shares in a transaction exempt from SEC registration. The extension is to allow additional time for satisfying closing conditions, including Nasdaq approval. No deal terms (price per share, premium) are disclosed. What to watch: Whether Nasdaq approval is obtained by the new deadline; risk-arb focus on regulatory timeline.
